# `struct`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Creates a struct with the given field values.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
struct(col1, col2, col3, ...)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `struct_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments |  |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- struct, example 1
> SELECT struct(1, 2, 3);
{"col1":1,"col2":2,"col3":3}
```
